welcome.heroSubtitle: Visually design directives for Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code. Real-time preview and seamless export without touching manual markdown.
welcome.templatesSubtitle: Select your project's technology stack to preload idiomatic directives and quality standards.
welcome.featureClientDesc: No backend, no accounts. Your directives live solely in your browser.
welcome.featureSyncDesc: Instant visual preview of the compiled file in real time.
welcome.featureExportDesc: Copy to clipboard or download your ready-to-use file.

presets.nextjsDesc: Server Components by default, typed Server Actions with Zod, async params/searchParams, and next/navigation.
presets.reactDesc: Modern architecture with React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, TanStack Query, and Zod.
presets.angularDesc: Cutting-edge directives for modern Angular: Signals, Zoneless, OnPush, inject(), and Tailwind CSS.
presets.vueDesc: Single File Components with <script setup lang="ts">, ref()/computed() reactivity, Pinia, and Nuxt useFetch.
presets.svelteDesc: Modern reactivity paradigm with Runes ($state, $derived, $props, $effect), reusable snippets, and SvelteKit 2.
presets.reactNativeDesc: Cross-platform mobile development (iOS & Android) with Expo Router, NativeWind, FlashList, and Reanimated.
presets.nestjsDesc: Enterprise modular architecture, thin controllers, DTOs with class-validator, Prisma, and OpenAPI.
presets.fastapiDesc: High-performance async APIs and AI backends with Pydantic v2, async SQLAlchemy 2, and Ruff.
presets.springbootDesc: Enterprise microservices with Java 21 Records, Virtual Threads, constructor injection, and Testcontainers.
presets.aspnetDesc: High-performance Clean Architecture, typed Minimal APIs, CQRS with MediatR, and async EF Core.
presets.goMicroservicesDesc: High-concurrency cloud-native microservices, standard layout, context.Context, sqlc + pgx, and slog.
presets.customDesc: Universal clean configuration without presets to define your agent from scratch.

targets.cursorDesc: YAML Frontmatter directives optimized for Cursor IDE
targets.agentsDesc: Open standard for autonomous coding agents with build & test commands
targets.claudeDesc: Concise operational contract for Claude Code CLI
targets.customDesc: Universal development directives contract in Markdown

builder.title: Rules Studio
builder.subtitle: Configure directives, architecture, and code conventions.
builder.resetConfigMessage: This action will clear all fields and restore the builder to a blank slate. Do you wish to continue?
builder.rolePlaceholder: E.g.: Senior Frontend Architect & Clean Code Expert
builder.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe the purpose of the application and how the agent should behave...
builder.toneSubtitle: Define the conciseness, autonomy, and interaction guidelines for the assistant
builder.toneSectionDesc: Control the conciseness and technical explanation depth of responses
builder.toneConciseDesc: Direct code without greetings, apologies, or conversational fluff.
builder.toneBalancedDesc: Code prioritized with essential context and key warnings.
builder.toneExplanatoryDesc: Explains architectural rationale and teaches best practices.
builder.autonomySectionDesc: Degree of initiative and technical independence when solving tasks
builder.autonomyConservativeDesc: Modifies only strictly requested lines without altering adjacent code.
builder.autonomyCollaborativeDesc: Asks and proposes alternatives when facing critical choices or ambiguity.
builder.autonomyAutonomousDesc: Resolves cascade errors, proposes validations, and acts proactively.
builder.commRulesSectionDesc: Directives to avoid unwanted LLM habits and preserve high code quality
builder.addCommRulePlaceholder: Add custom guideline... (e.g.: 'Do not use emojis in chat')
builder.noCommRules: No guidelines added yet. Pick from suggestions above or write a custom one.
builder.stackSubtitle: Define the core technologies and tools for the project
builder.stackPlaceholder: Type a technology (e.g.: Vitest, NestJS) and press Enter...
builder.directivesSubtitle: Rules and guidelines that the assistant must adhere to when generating code
builder.directivesPlaceholder: Type a custom directive and press Enter...
builder.noRulesSelected: No directives added yet. Type one or browse the catalog.
builder.modalSubtitle: Check the directives you want to apply to your agent. They sync in real time.
builder.workflowSubtitle: Define the commit and versioning standard for the assistant
builder.gitConventionPlaceholder: E.g.: Conventional Commits (feat, fix, refactor, docs, chore)...
builder.proposeCommitLabel: Always propose commit message upon completion

builder.customInstructionsSubtitle: Additional directives or boundaries the agent must not cross
builder.neverSectionDesc: Explicit negative boundaries the assistant must never cross
builder.noNeverRules: No prohibitions configured. Click suggestions above to safeguard your project.
builder.customInstructionsPlaceholder: Write any specific instructions or repository boundaries...
builder.designSubtitle: Visual standards, color palette, atomic components, and responsive design
builder.designPlaceholder: Type a design directive (e.g.: Dark-mode first) and press Enter...

compiler.gitDeliveryValue: Provide a structured commit message block at the end of each task.
compiler.toneConciseValue: Concise and direct (clean code without fluff or unnecessary apologies).
compiler.toneBalancedValue: Balanced (code focus with essential explanations and key caveats).
compiler.toneExplanatoryValue: Explanatory and mentoring (explains rationale and teaches best practices).
compiler.autonomyConservativeValue: Conservative and precise (modifies only strictly requested code without touching adjacent files).
compiler.autonomyCollaborativeValue: Collaborative (proposes alternatives and asks during design crossroads or ambiguity).
compiler.autonomyAutonomousValue: Autonomous and proactive (resolves cascade errors, proposes validations, and delivers end-to-end solutions).
